official_evidence: 2025-05-27 Shenzhen Market Supervision Bureau answer says commercial EV charging service fees are market-regulated and set by operators.
The Shenzhen charging-fee marking guide requires operators to display time-specific electricity, service fee and total price, but it does not set a citywide service-fee cap.
